rows.grounds: compound adjective qualifying devīm/tripurabhairavīm; describes the goddess as abiding in or attained to Mātṛbhairava
verb of salutation expressing the speaker's act of veneration
object of veneration, qualified by mātṛbhairavagām and identified as tripurabhairavīm
proper name of the goddess, in apposition to devīm

items.question: Which goddess abiding in Mātṛbhairava is the object of reverent salutation?
premises: The speaker performs an act of reverence.
The object of reverence is the goddess Tripurabhairavī.
Tripurabhairavī is characterized as abiding in Mātṛbhairava.
items.inference: The goddess Tripurabhairavī, in her aspect abiding in Mātṛbhairava, is the proper recipient of salutation.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of mātṛbhairavagām (gone to, attained to, or abiding in Mātṛbhairava) is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: I revere the goddess Tripurabhairavī, who abides in Mātṛbhairava.
